locked_detail: You chose where this project sits, so automatic organizing leaves it there.
report_later: A report on this project (what changed, milestones met, what’s next) arrives in a later version.
deep_hint: {levels} levels deep. That works, but {suggested} levels or fewer are easier to read.
no_children: Nothing under it yet. Drag a project onto it on the map, or choose Move to… in a project’s menu.
no_milestones: No milestones. Add one to flag a date and whether it was met.
no_yesterday: No notes on this project from yesterday.
title: Project tree
about: Your projects as a tree. Drag a project onto another to put it under it, or onto the center to move it to the top level; right-click or long-press for Move to…, Rename and milestones. Where you put a project stays: automatic organizing never moves it.
